**Learner ID:** L-39

**This week's practice plan:**

This week, we will continue to focus on **factorising by grouping**. We will build on the skills you've developed so far, with a particular emphasis on **correctly handling signs** during the grouping and factoring process.

**To avoid:**

*   **Flipping signs:** Pay close attention to the signs when you are grouping terms and when you are factoring out common factors. This has been a recurring area of difficulty (as noted in your feedback for question 4 and 7 on your last practice set). We will actively work on strategies to help you manage these signs accurately.
*   **Rushing through steps:** Take your time to write out each step clearly. This will help you to identify where sign errors might be occurring.
